name: Thabo Dlamini
bio:
Thabo Dlamini's path into motorsport logistics was somewhat unconventional. Starting as a mechanic's assistant in his youth, he quickly found his knack wasn't just for wrenching, but for organizing and streamlining the flow of parts and equipment. He honed his skills managing the inventory and transport for a local racing team for several years, developing a reputation for his meticulous attention to detail and his ability to solve logistical puzzles under pressure.

Now, as a logistics coordinator, Thabo brings a pragmatic and solutions-oriented approach. He believes that effective logistics is the backbone of any successful racing team, and he is dedicated to ensuring that everything runs smoothly, from the delivery of vital components to the efficient setup of the pit lane. He is always looking for ways to improve processes and reduce delays. Thabo's hands-on experience and deep understanding of racing operations make him a uniquely valuable asset, even at this stage of his career.

physical.description: Thabo is a solidly built man with a calm, focused gaze.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook and pen, even during meetings.
Has a specific system for packing and unpacking gear, and gets visibly agitated if it's disrupted.
Humming quietly to himself while meticulously checking inventory lists.
